def dist_sq(a, b):
    return (a[0]-b[0])**2 + (a[1]-b[1])**2 + (a[2]-b[2])**2

class CubicPoly:
    def __init__(self, x0, x1, x2, x3, dt0, dt1, dt2):
        # Three.js initNonuniformCatmullRom
        t1 = (x1 - x0) / dt0 - (x2 - x0) / (dt0 + dt1) + (x2 - x1) / dt1
        t2 = (x2 - x1) / dt1 - (x3 - x1) / (dt1 + dt2) + (x3 - x2) / dt2
        t1 *= dt1
        t2 *= dt1
        self.c0 = x1
        self.c1 = t1
        self.c2 = -3*x1 + 3*x2 - 2*t1 - t2
        self.c3 = 2*x1 - 2*x2 + t1 + t2

    def calc(self, t):
        t2 = t * t
        t3 = t2 * t
        return self.c0 + self.c1*t + self.c2*t2 + self.c3*t3

def eval_catmull_centripetal(pts, t):
    l = len(pts)
    p = l * t
    int_point = int(math.floor(p))
    weight = p - int_point

        weight = 1.0

    p2 = pts[(int_point + 1) % l]
    p3 = pts[(int_point + 2) % l]
